project_type: TypeScript monorepo - multi-source music aggregator with NestJS backend, Next.js frontend, Python AI services
build_system: pnpm workspaces (9.15.0), tsc for individual packages, no Turbo/Nx
test_framework: Not yet configured - will use vitest for unit tests, jest for NestJS integration
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, 2. pnpm run lint, 3. pnpm run typecheck, 4. pnpm run build, 5. pnpm run test
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install, 2. Copy .env.example to .env, 3. pnpm infra:up (docker compose), 4. pnpm run dev
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js 22 (default, 20 also available via nvm). Python 3.11. Docker available. pnpm available globally.
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits, ESLint + Prettier enforced, lint-staged pre-commit hooks, strict TypeScript
key_patterns: Workspace packages use 'workspace:*' for internal deps. ESM modules for packages (type: module), CommonJS for NestJS API app. tsconfig.base.json extends pattern. Root scripts delegate to packages via 'pnpm -r'.
directory_structure: apps/api (NestJS backend), apps/web (Next.js frontend), services/ai (Python FastAPI), packages/shared (TS contracts), packages/connectors/{yandex-music,youtube-music,file-import} (connector implementations), docker/ (initdb scripts)
